title: A working harbour
text:
Brinehaven's harbour and boats rebuilt to look like the real thing.

✨ A stone breakwater now shelters Brinehaven's harbour: walk out along it to the green harbour beacon at its end
⬆️ New boats with proper planked hulls, raked bows, transoms and painted waterlines: rowing boats with oars, fishing boats with rigging, nets and lanterns, and a merchant cog with an aft castle, a square sail and full rigging
⬆️ Every boat is tied to the piers with mooring lines. A merchant ship lies at anchor outside, and rowing boats are pulled up on the beach by the fishing huts
⬆️ The piers have weed at the waterline, cleats, ladders down to the water, lobster pots and coiled rope, and channel buoys mark the way in
